info.description:
Auth is the `session` cookie set by `POST /api/auth/login`; routes that need it answer 401 without it. Swagger 2.0 has no cookie security scheme, so the spec declares none.
Routes under `/api/admin/` answer 403 `admin only` for a signed-in non-admin.
Every error body is `{"error": "<message>"}`.
Request bodies are capped at 64 KB, except the two statement import routes; a larger body with a declared Content-Length answers 413 `request body: larger than 64 KB`; one sent without a length is cut off at 64 KB and answers the route's 400.
Rate-limited routes answer 429 `too many requests` with a `Retry-After` header.
A POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE from another origin answers 403 `cross-origin request`.

post.description: Creates the import and all its transactions in one database transaction; the first invalid row rolls everything back. For broker csv the period is the committed rows' dates and the one sent is used only when it has no rows; when no row has a valid date, the first row's own error is returned. Each of the optional aliases is stored in the same database transaction as the user's pick for that symbol in this broker's statements, replacing an earlier pick; the next preview resolves an unknown symbol with it. Each of the optional names, the preview's names, is stored the same way as a learned fund name, replacing an earlier learned name but never a pick; a name sent with instrument_id 0 or with two different instruments is stored for neither and removes a learned one. A row may be dated the day before period_start, the date of the preview's opening rows, or the day after period_end, when Midas books the interest of the month it prints. The body is capped at 2 MB instead of 64 KB.

post.description: Reads an uploaded PDF statement (a CSV file for broker csv) and returns the proposed rows for review. Writes no user data; it may add shared market data: the instruments and prices described below, and the prices and FX rates fetched to price an opening buy. A TEFAS row whose fund code is no instrument is asked about on TEFAS, at most 10 codes a request and within the client IP's 20 TEFAS lookups a minute shared with /imports/funds, and the fund TEFAS confirms is added; a code not asked stays unknown_instrument. A trade or dividend in BIST whose symbol is no instrument, such as a share delisted since, is looked up again after the BIST bulletin of its date is synced, fetching at most 5 bulletins a request and within the client IP's 10 bulletin fetches a minute; the sync adds the symbols that bulletin lists as instruments, shared market data like their prices. The TEFAS lookups and bulletin syncs of one request share a 15 s deadline; none starts after it, and the rows they would have resolved stay unknown_instrument. With broker auto, a PDF goes through every PDF parser in key order and the first that accepts it picks the broker: the response's broker is that key, and everything below uses it as if it had been sent. A symbol that resolves to no instrument takes the instrument the user picked for it in an earlier commit of the same broker (commit's aliases); such a row has resolved_by "alias" and names that instrument in instrument_symbol and instrument_name. A holding resolves through the same pick, so its reconciliation entry and opening follow it. The optional picks are the instruments the user picked in this preview so far, in the shape of commit's aliases: for this request only, each resolves its symbol like a stored pick and wins over one, so rows, openings and the reconciliation follow it; nothing is stored. When the statement holds more of an instrument at period end than the portfolio would with the ok rows, and the portfolio has no transaction of it before period_start, an opening buy of the difference dated the day before period_start is proposed (opening true), priced with the average cost the statement prints for the holding when it is in the instrument's currency and the preview has no buy of it (cost_price true), else with the stored price on or before that date, for a BIST instrument also once the BIST bulletin of the last weekday on or before that date is synced (one sync a request, within the client IP's 10 bulletin fetches a minute and the opening fetches' deadline), else the statement's own price when the holding is in the instrument's currency (approximate_price true), else returned as an error row with code opening_price; one opening deposit per currency pays for the priced buys. When the statement lists holdings and the portfolio would hold more of an instrument at period end than the statement, holding it before period_start, a closing sell of the difference, at most what it held the day before period_start, is proposed on that day (closing true), priced like an opening buy but never with the average cost, else returned as an error row with code closing_price; one closing withdrawal per currency (closing true) takes the priced sells' proceeds out again, rounded down to the cent. Closing rows are left out of the reconciliation, as the page starts the sells unchecked and books the withdrawal in step with the checked ones. Nothing is proposed while any buy or sell row is unknown_instrument, unless the units of every such symbol's buy and sell rows net to zero. The reconciliation includes them. names lists each fund name the balances print (Garanti fund statements) with the instrument of its code, for the commit's names; its instrument_id is 0 when they print it for two codes or its code resolves to no instrument. A symbol that neither an instrument nor a pick resolves takes the one instrument of the learned names that equal it, start with it or that it starts with, with resolved_by "name" and instrument_symbol and instrument_name set; matches of more than one instrument leave it unknown_instrument, and so does a symbol that is one of the statement's holding codes or that matches one of its own balance names the same way (the parser leaves such a name unmapped only when it names two funds). A garanti TEFAS row's symbol none of that resolves, and that is neither such a holding code nor such a balance name, takes the one TEFAS fund whose name it is cut or abbreviated from: word by word, GPY and GP read as GARANTİ PORTFÖY and 1., 2., 3. as BİRİNCİ, İKİNCİ, ÜÇÜNCÜ, each of its words starts the fund name's word in the same place, case and punctuation ignored. A fund of the same words, else of the same words but a cut last one, wins over the others; it has resolved_by "name" too, and two funds of the closest kind leave it unknown_instrument. The optional names, in the shape of the response's names, are fund names other statements print, such as the later statements of the same upload batch: for this request only, each is a learned name, winning over a stored one of the same name, so a fund renamed on TEFAS that an earlier statement names only by its old name resolves; an entry of instrument_id 0 is ignored and nothing is stored. The body is capped at 5 MB instead of 64 KB.

get.description: How the scope's return from `from` to `to` splits into price, income and currency, in the reporting currency, as 2-decimal strings. `from` and `to` are resolved like the history route's, and the response carries the range actually used. total.price is the positions' price plus the scope's cash costs (standalone fee rows, fees on deposits and withdrawals); total.income is the positions' income plus interest; total.fx is the positions' currency effect and total.cash_fx the currency effect on cash. A term deposit's price change is income. The first price of an instrument held without one when the range opens is not counted: its jump from cost to market is a flow, as in the history route's net_flow. positions lists every instrument that had a position on a day of the range or any activity after `from`; closed is true when its quantity is zero on `to`; its total is the sum of the unrounded buckets, rounded once. Each bucket is rounded to 2 decimals on its own, so the four rounded totals can differ from the rounded change in total value less net flows by up to 0.02. A bucket is null when a day of the range had no rate to convert it; missing_rates lists those currencies.

400.description: to must be YYYY-MM-DD; from must be YYYY-MM-DD; from must not be after to; range exceeds 3660 days

get.description: One bucket per calendar month from the month of the first transaction to the current month, oldest first, zero-filled, plus totals over every month, in the reporting currency at each transaction's own-date rate (not today's, which would rewrite history). deposits and withdrawals are the gross amounts, net is deposits minus withdrawals, fees are the fee of every buy, sell, deposit and withdrawal plus the amount and fee of a fee row, dividends are dividends with an instrument net of their fee (stopaj), interest is a dividend without an instrument net of its fee; a split counts nothing. Every bucket is rounded once from its exact sum, so the months can differ from the totals by a cent. A row whose currency has no rate on or before its date is left out of every field and its currency listed in missing_rates. No transactions give no months and zero totals. Amounts are 2-decimal strings.

Newest start date first. value is today's net value (principal plus the net interest accrued), payout the principal plus the net interest at maturity, both 2 decimals. status is matured when a sell is recorded on the deposit, else due from the maturity date, else active.

Decimals are strings with at most 15 integer and 9 fraction digits; rate and stopaj_rate are fractions (0.45 for 45%).

closed.description: quantity zero on the last day

estimated_from.description: first extrapolated TUFE day, null when none

fund.description: Fund books a cash deposit of the principal on the start date as well.

accrued_interest.description: AccruedInterest is Value minus the principal.

net_interest_at_maturity.description: NetInterestAtMaturity is the interest over the whole term, after stopaj.

payout.description: Payout is the principal plus NetInterestAtMaturity.

renewed_from.description:
RenewedFrom is the id of the deposit this one renews, null for a deposit
opened on its own.

status.description:
Status is matured (a sell is recorded on the deposit), else due (today is
on or after the maturity date), else active.

value.description: Value is the principal plus the net interest accrued up to today, 2 decimals.

last_12_months.description: One bucket over the current month and the eleven before it, period its first month; summed unrounded, so the rounded month buckets need not add up to it.

total.description: One bucket over every dividend recorded, period empty; summed unrounded, so the rounded year buckets need not add up to it.

gross.description: Gross, Stopaj and Net are the interest over the whole term, 2 decimals.

benchmark_twr.description:
BenchmarkTWR is the same for the benchmark's shadow series: null on
every point without a benchmark, when the shadow has no value, or when
benchmark.returns.twr is null (ADR 0012).

benchmark_value.description:
BenchmarkValue is the shadow portfolio's value on this day in the
reporting currency, set only when a benchmark was requested and is
available for the range (ADR 0012).

invested.description:
Invested is the money in the portfolio that is not gain: the first
point's value plus the net external flows since, counted as net_flow
counts them. total_value - invested is the gain the chart header
shows, and the last point's invested minus the first's equals net_flow.

price_unknown.description:
PriceUnknown is set on a point that holds at least one instrument with
no price on or before its date. Those holdings count at cost in
total_value, so the point is incomplete, not wrong by the whole
holding (ADR 0003).

twr.description:
TWR is the time-weighted return from the range's first point to this
one, a fraction with 6 decimals: "0.000000" on the first point, the
range's returns.twr on the last. null on every point when returns.twr
is null (ADR 0011).

benchmark.description:
Benchmark is the ?benchmark= comparison: the shadow portfolio that
put the same external flows into the benchmark (ADR 0012,
docs/adr/0012-benchmarks.md). null when no benchmark was requested.

inflation.description:
Inflation is the TUFE change over the range, levels[last] /
levels[first] - 1 with 6 decimals, whatever benchmark was requested
(ADR 0012). null unless the reporting currency is TRY, and when TUFE
has no level on or before the first point.

inflation_estimated_from.description:
InflationEstimatedFrom is the first day of the range whose TUFE level
is extrapolated past the last stored month, null when none is or when
inflation is null.

missing_prices.description:
MissingPrices is the union, over every point with price_unknown, of
the symbols held with no price yet on that point's date.

net_flow.description:
NetFlow is the external cash that entered the portfolio after the
first point: deposits minus withdrawals dated after `from`, each
converted at its own day's rate like everything else in the series
(ADR 0003). Anything dated on or before `from` is already inside the
first point's total, so it is not counted here. The chart header
subtracts it from last - first, so money put in is not shown as a
gain. A flow whose currency has no rate on its own day is
carried and counted on the first later day that has one, because
that is the day its cash enters total_value.

The gross amount is counted, not the amount net of its fee: a fee is
a cost, and costs belong in the performance the chart shows, exactly
like the fee on a buy, a sell or a standalone fee row, none of which
is a flow either.

It also holds the first-price jump of every holding the first point
had no price for: on the day its first price lands, its value moves
from cost to market in one step, and that move is gain made before
the range as much as inside it, so it is counted here rather than as
the range's gain.

returns.description:
Returns is the range's simple, time-weighted and money-weighted
return (ADR 0011), from each point's total_value and the same
external flows net_flow counts, taken on the day they land. All three
are null when the first point's total_value is not positive or any
point's cash is negative.

benchmark.description:
Benchmark is the benchmark's returns over the same range, null
without ?benchmark= or when the benchmark has no level on some day of
the range (ADR 0012).

from.description: first day, the period's first or the first transaction

partial.description: the first and the current bucket

to.description: last day, the period's last or today

fund.description: Fund books the amount as a cash deposit before each buy.

status.description:
Status is ended (the next occurrence is past the end date), else due
(the next occurrence is today or past), else active.

cash.description:
Cash and UnrealizedPL in the reporting currency, taken from the same
holdings.Convert result as TotalValue, so they leave out the same
MissingRates currencies. UnrealizedPL is null under
summaryResponse.UnrealizedPL's rule: when every currency contributing
to it was excluded for lack of a rate, the sum is 0.00 only because
nothing was added to it, and a caller must render "-" rather than a
figure that reads as a real zero.

missing_rates.description:
MissingRates lists the currencies whose amounts TotalValue leaves out
for want of a conversion factor -- same field and same semantics as
summaryResponse.MissingRates: it names what was excluded, not what is
absent from the rate table (see holdings.Totals.Missing).
Without it the list silently understates a portfolio.

benchmark_twr.description:
BenchmarkTwr is the same for the benchmark's shadow series, null without
a benchmark, when the shadow has no value, or when benchmark.returns.twr
is null (ADR 0012).

close.description: latest close on or before date, null before the first price

twr.description: running time-weighted return from returns_from, null before it or when the range's is null

benchmark.description: the ?benchmark= shadow position, null when none was requested

returns_from.description: first day with a close, null when there is none

returns_to.description: last day of the series the returns run on, null when returns_from is

asset_class.description: the instrument's stored class (equity, fund, ...), null when it has none

closed.description:
True for a closed position: no quantity left, listed for its
realized P/L. A quantity of 0 alone does not mean closed: in the
all-portfolios view a long and an equal short position in two
portfolios sum to 0 and stay open.

day_change.description:
The move of the position as held at the end of price_date, in the
position's currency: shares bought or sold on price_date move from their
own trade price, and trades dated after it are ignored.

day_change_base.description:
What day_change is a percentage of, in the position's currency: the
value of the shares it counts, at prev_close for those held before
price_date (also those sold on or after it) and at their own price for
those bought on price_date. Shares bought after price_date are left
out. Null whenever day_change is null; "0.00" when no counted share was
held or bought by price_date, so there is no percentage.

day_change_reporting.description: day_change in the reporting currency; also null without a rate.

fx_pl_reporting.description:
The currency part of the position's gain in the reporting currency:
cost_basis at today's rate minus the cost with each buy converted at
its own trade date's rate. The price part is unrealized_pl_reporting.
Null on closed positions, on positions in the reporting currency, and
when today's rate or any open buy's trade-date rate is missing.

market.description: BIST, US, TEFAS, CRYPTO or GOLD

prev_close.description:
The latest close dated before price_date (manual winning on a date,
like last_price), scaled by any split after its date up to today. It,
prev_price_date, day_change, day_change_reporting and day_change_base
are null when either price is missing or the position is closed (a
closed position's move still counts in the summary's day_change).

price_source.description:
Where last_price came from ("manual" for the caller's own entry, else
the fetching provider) and the date it is dated. Null when there is no
price. The page needs both to tag a manual price and to address it for
deletion -- DELETE /api/instruments/{id}/prices/{date}.

realized_cost.description:
The cost of every share sold, in the position's currency: the base
realized_pl is a return on. Kept after the position closes.
Zero, or even negative, after a short: no base for a percentage.

sector.description: a sector key (financials, ...); "unknown" when there is no data

splits.description:
The splits the holdings engine applied to this position, oldest
first: dated after the instrument's first transaction in this
portfolio, on or before today, and while shares were held.
Never null.

total_pl_reporting.description:
Unrealized plus realized P/L in the reporting currency, summed
unrounded and rounded once, so it can differ from the two rounded
fields' sum by a cent. Null without a rate.

monthly_gap.description:
MonthlyGap is the smallest extra monthly flow, in the reporting
currency and rounded up, that lets the median path reach the amount by
the target month, null when it reaches it anyway.

reached_at.description:
ReachedAt is the first month of the median path at or above the
amount, the current month when today's value already is at the amount,
null when none is.

error.description:
Error is "undecryptable" when the stored key cannot be read (SECRET_KEY
changed), so the admin can enter it again.

net_contribution.description:
deposits less withdrawals, and dividends_gross less dividends_tax,
each worked out unrounded and rounded once, so either can differ from
the rounded fields' difference by a cent.

by_currency.description: One entry per currency any row moved, in that currency.

first_transaction_date.description: The earliest transaction date in scope; null with no transactions.

reporting.description:
by_currency summed into the reporting currency at today's rate. Null
when any by_currency entry with a nonzero figure has no rate, rather
than a partial sum; missing_rates names that currency.

cash_by_currency_reporting.description:
Each cash_by_currency entry converted into the reporting currency,
keyed by its own currency. A currency with no rate is left out; it is
named in missing_rates.

day_change.description:
The open positions' day_change_reporting, plus the move on price_date
of closed positions sold out on or after it, summed unrounded and
rounded once, so it can differ from the rounded rows' sum by a cent.
A position with no previous close or no rate is left out; null when
none is left, so the page shows "-" rather than a zero.

fx_pl.description:
FXPL is the part of the return that neither P/L figure holds: the
currency move on foreign cash and on the cost of foreign positions,
both of which unrealized and realized P/L value at today's rate.
Null when the portfolio has no currency other than the
reporting one, or when every such currency was excluded for lack of a
rate -- the same rule as the P/L fields above.

positions_value.description:
The open positions' market value and cost in the reporting currency,
leaving out the same missing_rates currencies as total_value. Each is
summed unrounded and rounded once, so it matches the rows and history's
cost_basis; total_value less cash less unrealized_pl, each already
rounded, can be a cent off.

unrealized_pl.description:
Null when every currency contributing to the total was excluded for
lack of a rate (see totalKnown): the sum is then 0.00, which reads as
a real zero next to the per-position figures. The caller renders "-"
instead, the way it already does for a position with no reporting
value. Cash and total value stay plain strings: the page can tell the
same thing for those from cash_by_currency and market_value_reporting,
but realized P/L also counts closed positions, whose
currencies reach no other field of this response.

day_change.description: last_price - prev_close with 2 decimals; null unless both exist.

last_price.description:
The latest close on or before today (the caller's manual price wins on
the same date, else the newer row), scaled by the splits since its
date, in the instrument's currency; null without a close. Where it came
from ("manual" or the fetched source) and its date.

prev_close.description:
The latest close dated before price_date, scaled the same way, and its
date; null without one.

target_reached.description:
Whether last_price has reached target_price: at or above it for side
"above", at or below it for "below". False without a target or a close.

best.description:
Best and worst are the instruments with the largest and the smallest
price + income + fx over the year, null when none has every rate.

from.description: first day, Jan 1 or the first transaction

gain.description: Gain is closing - opening - net_flow, exact on the rounded figures.

inflation.description:
Inflation is TÜFE's change over from..to, as the history route
computes it; null unless the reporting currency is TRY.

partial.description: the first and the current year

inflation_estimated_from.description:
InflationEstimatedFrom is the first TÜFE day that is extrapolated, null
when none is or when inflation is not served.

currency.description:
Currency is the statement's account currency, "" when unknown or a
CSV. It tells the TRY and USD statements of the same month apart.

cash_reconciliation.description:
CashReconciliation is null when the statement printed no cash
balance or no currency.

names.description:
Names are the fund names the balances printed, each once with the
instrument of its code (0: see statementNames), in the shape of
commit's aliases, for the client to send back as commit's names.
Left out for a statement that prints none.

approximate_price.description:
ApproximatePrice marks an opening buy priced with the statement's own
period-end price, as no stored price exists for its date.

closing.description:
Closing marks a sell the preview proposes, dated the day before
period_start, for what the portfolio holds and the statement does not.
It starts unchecked: the gap may be months not imported.

cost_price.description:
CostPrice marks an opening buy priced with the average cost the
statement prints for the holding.

currency_fallback.description:
CurrencyFallback marks a row the file gave no currency for: Currency
is the instrument's, TRY when none, so a pick in the page
takes the picked instrument's.

duplicate_of.description:
DuplicateOf is the date of an earlier transaction, hand-entered or
imported, this row likely repeats (see flagDuplicates); the client
starts such a row unchecked.

instrument_symbol.description:
InstrumentSymbol and InstrumentName name the instrument of a row
resolved by an earlier pick, whose symbol is the statement's own, so
the user sees what the pick resolved it to.

market.description:
Market is the row's own market hint, as a CSV row can carry one; empty
when it has none.

opening.description:
Opening marks a row the preview proposes for what the account held
before period_start: a buy dated the day before it, or the deposit
that pays for those buys.

resolved_by.description:
ResolvedBy is "alias" when the instrument is the user's own earlier
pick for this symbol rather than a match of it, "name" when
it is the fund an earlier statement's balances printed under this name.

unknown_instrument.description:
UnknownInstrument marks an error row whose symbol is unknown as well,
so the preview still says so once checkRow made it an error.

instrument_id.description:
InstrumentID is required for buy and sell, optional for dividend (a
dividend with none is interest income), and rejected for the rest.

import_id.description:
ImportID is null for a hand-entered transaction, set for one that came
from a broker statement import.
